en.headline: Observatory issues Yellow Fire Danger Warning as risk rises
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the Yellow Fire Danger Warning at 6am on Sunday, advising the public and hikers to take precautions against fires.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Yellow Fire Danger Warning at 6am on Sunday, 22 November, stating that the fire risk is high.
The Observatory said the countryside is vulnerable to fire and urged people to prevent fires from breaking out. Hikers were advised to remain vigilant.
The warning remains in force until further notice. The previous Red Fire Danger Warning, which indicated extreme risk, was cancelled late on Saturday night.
Officials reminded the public that lighting fires illegally in the countryside carries a maximum penalty of a HK$25,000 fine and one year's imprisonment.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 火險頗高
zh.dek: 香港天文台周日上午六時發出黃色火災危險警告，提醒市民及遠足人士採取防火措施，郊野火險頗高。
body: 香港天文台於11月22日上午六時發出黃色火災危險警告，指現時火災危險性頗高。
天文台表示，郊野容易發生火警，呼籲市民小心防火，遠足人士亦應提高警覺，防止山火發生。
警告將持續生效，直至另行通知。此前於周六晚取消的紅色火災危險警告，曾指火險極高。
當局提醒，在郊野非法燃點火種，最高可被罰款二萬五千元及監禁一年。
